high_level_description: The image is an aerial view of an island in Mauritius, showcasing a striking optical illusion known as the "Underwater Waterfall." The text at the top of the image describes this phenomenon: "This optical illusion, visible only from above, makes it appear as if the island is being pulled into a massive drain due to sand and silt runoff on the ocean floor." Setting: The image captures a tropical island surrounded by clear blue waters. The island is lush with green vegetation, indicating a healthy ecosystem.
